description: North sea shipping forecast is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by dataplatform.knmi.nl. The North Sea shipping forecast covers the North Sea, divided into 5 districts: Dogger, German Bight, Humber, Thames and Dover. Coverage: NL. Its keywords include Open data. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
